mechanism_inventory.name: per-flow / per-connection bandwidth sharing
mechanism_inventory.physical_motivation: fair sharing among concurrent TCP flows at a shared bottleneck (documented)
mechanism_inventory.infrastructure: shared bottleneck replay exists (mm-link); no per-flow fairness instrumentation live
mechanism_inventory.live_evidence: M3 aggregate throughput envelope: no C sensitivity

mechanism_inventory.name: server-side concurrency cap or queueing
mechanism_inventory.physical_motivation: servers limit concurrent connections/workers (documented server behavior)
mechanism_inventory.infrastructure: the controlled server has no concurrency cap; would need a server change
mechanism_inventory.live_evidence: T1: per-response pacing, no live reversal at equal granularity

mechanism_inventory.name: queueing/overhead that grows with concurrent requests
mechanism_inventory.physical_motivation: server per-connection processing cost (context switching, memory) degrades aggregate capacity
mechanism_inventory.infrastructure: not present in the controlled server
mechanism_inventory.live_evidence: L4 GATE E: the simulated over-concurrency penalty did NOT survive live (NOT_READY_LIVE_MISMATCH)

mechanism_inventory.name: background traffic competing for a shared bottleneck
mechanism_inventory.physical_motivation: background flows share the bottleneck; fair sharing reduces the downloader's share
mechanism_inventory.infrastructure: tc/netem background traffic possible in principle; not part of the current controlled stack

mechanism_inventory.name: contention where additional flows increase queueing delay
mechanism_inventory.live_evidence: T1/L4: no live concurrency penalty observed

mechanism_inventory.name: server request-processing capacity that saturates as N increases
mechanism_inventory.live_evidence: T1: aggregate scales monotonically with C

mechanism_inventory.name: changing available capacity + per-flow sharing
mechanism_inventory.live_evidence: S pivot shared model: no state-dependent preference
